question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_lr,
    STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS std_lr
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
)
SELECT 
  s.avg_lr,
  s.std_lr,
  s.avg_lr - s.std_lr AS lower_bound,
  s.avg_lr + s.std_lr AS upper_bound,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v."loss_rate_%" < s.avg_lr - s.std_lr) AS below_one_std,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v."loss_rate_%" >= s.avg_lr - s.std_lr AND v."loss_rate_%" <= s.avg_lr + s.std_lr) AS within_one_std,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v."loss_rate_%" > s.avg_lr + s.std_lr) AS above_one_std
FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, stats s
GROUP BY s.avg_lr, s.std_lr
